purpose: record that Forecast Assessment v11 closes the currently identified caller-supplied, locally machine-checkable provenance stack and prevent additional local commitment layers from being misrepresented as external trust evidence

stronger_evidence_required.external_timestamping: an independently verifiable timestamp or append-only-log inclusion commitment tied to the relevant digest
stronger_evidence_required.independent_witnessing: an independently controlled signed attestation with verifiable witness identity or key provenance
stronger_evidence_required.checkpoint_preexistence: an external commitment demonstrably created before the protected evaluation-access event
stronger_evidence_required.real_world_access_history_completeness: trusted execution or access infrastructure that can support completeness of the recorded history rather than a caller-supplied log alone
stronger_evidence_required.whole_chain_and_checkpoint_cofabrication: an external trust anchor that existed before evaluation access and is not controlled solely by the same caller supplying the chain
stronger_evidence_required.genuine_predeclaration: an independently timestamped or otherwise externally committed preregistration or declaration predating outcome access
